model_description.level_note: Operator formulas are not reconstructed from the UFO; operators are identified at the UFO parameter level (LHC block ANOINPUTS, index, name).

dataset_summary_table_note: Every count is the actual LHCO/CSV count; banner targets are never used. final_state_cut_cross_section_pb applies the final-state particle-number cut efficiency only (no ML threshold).

features.physical_definition: x momentum of the leading jet
y momentum of the leading jet
z momentum of the leading jet
x momentum of the subleading jet
y momentum of the subleading jet
z momentum of the subleading jet
missing momentum x component = negative sum of visible px
missing momentum y component = negative sum of visible py

feature_preprocessing.implementation: sklearn Pipeline(StandardScaler, classifier) saved per algorithm

numerical_validation.method: independent recalculation of every S=2,3,5 interval from the recorded fixed-intercept fits, luminosity, units, and Asimov significance definition

algorithm_selection.selection_rationale: The common anchor strategy gives usable fixed-intercept fits and finite S=2,3,5 constraints for every claimed operator.
